That moves through nicely. I scrolled to the bottom of the first twenty and hit "Show 20 more," and the same list just kept going with the next twenty items rather than jumping me to a separate page, and the count at the top ticked from "Showing 20 of 120" to "Showing 40 of 120," so I always know where I am and how much is left. Revealing it in batches instead of dumping all 120 rows at once feels right — it stays quick and I'm not hunting across pages; it's one continuous collection I can keep pulling more of as I go.

I'm happy with that. What's next?
